//: These scenarios are built by the desktop MSBuild from Visual Studio Build Tools, not by 'dotnet',
because they cover behaviours that only manifest under the .NET Framework-hosted compiler. The build
agent carries Visual Studio Build Tools 17.14, whose MSBuild is 17.14.x, and the SDK pinned in the
repository root global.json requires MSBuild 18 or later. Without this file MSBuild resolves the root
global.json and fails with 'Version 10.0.301 of the .NET SDK requires at least version 18.0.0 of
MSBuild', then MSB4236 'The SDK Microsoft.NET.Sdk specified could not be found'.
Pinning the 10.0.1xx band keeps these two scenarios on an SDK that MSBuild 17.14 can host. The
version has to stay installed on the agent, so it is declared as a second DotNetComponent in
eng-Metalama/src/Program.cs. Remove this file once PostSharp.Engineering offers an 18.x
VisualStudioBuildToolsComponentVersion and the agent moves to it.
